title: Panel Builder: visual UI authoring
description: Drag nodes from the palette, drop them onto the canvas, then edit their properties in the inspector.

steps.hint: The Panel Builder authors PanelSpec JSON visually. Three panes: palette on the left, live canvas in the middle, inspector on the right.
The palette lists every node kind you can drop — stacks, text, sliders, buttons. Drag a tile onto the canvas to add it.
The canvas previews your draft live. Drop palette tiles here. Click a node to select it.
The inspector shows the selected node's properties. Edit a label, change a colour, or delete the node — every change reflects in the canvas immediately.
